steps.name: [Job] Snake Shadow
steps.objective: Please press the quest completion button.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: This terrible energy... , it is not from the Deimos Church that I know of. No, I think there's something mixed up... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel that way too. There's definitely something inside the meteorite.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: It seems like it will take a long time to deal with the alien beings coming out of here and even get inside.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: So while I cut down the beings coming out, I would like %s to go inside and check for any signs of ominous energy or relics.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I go?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: %s is not only recognized by Master, but also because you can do what I cannot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have I also been recognized by L?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I have nothing but respect for talented people in any field.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Ghost… Just don't make fun of me for being afraid of the same thing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've never made fun of you. Hehe… .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Now, hurry up. This is enough for chatting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll be back.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Yes, I will move right away too.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: This is Master’s hometown… .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Let's finish the work here perfectly for the sake of my brother and the teacher who took me away and then return.
(In the deepest part of the planet of nothingness, a suspicious energy is felt.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where am I?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I wandered around and ended up inside, but that thing I see over there... .
(A snake-shaped being with a suspicious energy is staring at you.)
Oh, you're from Luminous.
Since he managed to find where I am, it's clear that he led the way. Anyway, I was waiting. Owner of the card.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, do you know me? I don't think it's a typical snake... . A snake that speaks human language!! Really, Ouroboros?!
Seeing as I know his name... . But, I'm not him.
Suddenly, I remember what he said to you. It's a huge hindrance to your work! If you don't deal with it there, you'll regret it!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ouroboros!! Where is Ouroboros now?
Why are you so impatient? Even though I am not him, I am his shadow… . Let's call it snake shadow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will ask you again. Where is Ouroboros?

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: It's annoying, you. It tells me something other than his location.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: From where to where should I talk? Are you saying that there are more than one person who has the same soul as you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I suddenly feel a chill coming from the snake shadow’s words.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ooh, Ouroboros is up to something.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Even if you don’t understand it, you feel it instinctively, right?

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: His will speaks. to swallow you If I swallow you, even the gods here will acknowledge you.
(Suddenly the snake shadow gets sick of its appetite.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: The reason I met you here is because of his will, which he calls ‘fate.’ So I will swallow you clean.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: I will swallow anything that disturbs him. Because that's what I do.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: But, just as God changed the fate of this world, I also wanted to do the same. The power you have, maybe I can escape his will... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You are the shadow of Ouroboros and you defy him. Do you want to become a god?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I think I know something more than that... .

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Maybe I know what you're looking for? If you can't handle the truth, it's wiser to just be swallowed. Now, choose.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: You can't stop the will from being activated just because you don't want it. Because I and he want it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will make you regret those words. Finding Ouroboros is the path for everyone.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: If possible.
(No sooner has the snake shadow finished speaking than it opens its mouth wide, exposing its huge fangs.)

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Big, big... .

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: This can't be... . His will could be pushed aside by a mere human... .

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: No matter how much of a shadow I am... .
(The movement of the snake's shadow becomes slower. Then, the image gradually begins to blur.)

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: He no longer allows my presence... .

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: … Am I going to disappear like this?

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Just because I, who had lived to protect his will for a long time, was pushed aside by humans... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: say. Where is Ouroboros?

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Even if I don't answer, your will will find him. Because you are not an ordinary human being.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What kind of person am I?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An ordinary student in Luminous City obtained a mana card. I can't go back from then.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: I don't think that's the case... .

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: You really don't know yourself. Seeing as you don't know the truth about the cards. Hehe… . The road to oblivion, it suits you.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Those who went from humans to gods also don't know many things. If you want to know... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does that mean? say!!

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Let me see the truth that God does not know where I am gone. She will give you the wisest answer.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Ouroboros. How can I be like this... . this… .
(The snake's shadow disappears and is no longer visible.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ouroboros, answer me!! Where are you?! Are you looking at me?
(An illusion of Iris appears before %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, Iris?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s, sorry for appearing so suddenly… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The snake shadow told me to look at the spot where it disappeared... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: That's it over there... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah… , but do you see something?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I guess it's something only I can see. Only my eyes can see... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Well then, I'll take a quick look and tell you.
(The illusion of Iris stares at the spot where the snake shadow disappeared.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Suddenly the memory of that time comes to mind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Why do these memories come to mind? Are these also what Iris is seeing?)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Who is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris seems to be the person who is curious.)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: I am Nii. Guardian of Luminous City... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Nii…. Nii’s image comes to mind clearly. Is she okay?)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: The people of Luminous City do not yet know of its existence, but soon Luminous will also become a part of this world.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: As long as we remain here to prevent the collapse of this world, you are the only one who can pursue Ouroboros.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Sorry, Odin... I haven't found it yet.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For Iris, I need to quickly gain more superhuman strength….)

lines.speaker: 라현
lines.text: This is not the time to talk about such things. The child who was captured by Ouroboros... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This is….)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Beyond time, to the world of the past... . My lovely, destined child... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ellie? Why are you saying that? Ugh... I feel an inexplicable pain... But why does it overlap with Emperor Gendia's appearance? Why did I feel it only now?)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Are you… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It seems like Ellie, who Iris and I were looking at, suddenly makes eye contact. I guess it's just my mood...?)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: You're looking at me now, Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Suddenly….)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Iris… . A world without pain and sadness was created just as Iris wanted.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: You, whom Ceres loves, this place, created by your will, is a very happy place.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: However, Ouroboros woke up after misunderstanding the meaning of Iris. I'm trying to create a world without everything.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I knew it, but… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It was because of me. I… . I… .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Iris, it's not your fault. It's the fault of those who bully you.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Now trying to eat your world... .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Just as Odin and Nii have protected it from the past to the present, both Iris and %s can do it.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: It's never your fault. You will become a great god... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ellie… .

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: %s, we will meet someday. Before that, let me first ask you about Iris.
(With those words, the figures that appeared in front gradually disappear.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, are you okay? That's not Iris's fault.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: A being who woke up in a world I created... , Ouroboros… .
(Iris looks shocked.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Ah, Iris? Iris, are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, Iris?
(Iris's appearance does not move as if it has stopped and then suddenly disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris? Where have you gone? Huh… .. what? How does this feel?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Suddenly, everything in front of my vision becomes distorted. A black chasm opens and begins to suck everyone in.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … This, this… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Suddenly, the scene in Moros where Van disappears comes to mind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh no!! We have to get out of here!!
